scripts.package: dotnet publish -c Release -o bin/Release/net8.0/publish && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Force -Path bin/Release/net8.0/publish/* -DestinationPath bin/Release/net8.0/publish/LocktonOrion.Functions.zip"
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run package && serverless deploy --stage dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run package && serverless deploy --stage prod
